test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'SUN' is written as 'RTTVMO' and 'JOB' is written as 'IKNPAC'. How will 'PIE' be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'SUN' is written as 'RTTVMO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40794bdce63bf0952a5f41d16c17d874fd76b11b0470fcb1eb592bea3de34013.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff0abca4630fa8dfa255c43504c339de520d6b38c457ec57581a8fde9a21f6d6.png] 

And,

'JOB' is written as 'IKNPAC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/288e5617563544572a92baf7dd30eecc6a33980c43d3f9bb01bda858ef4924f2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b61580beba2d3582b85c6bb5e15fe9eb99fb7f32e22ea02b3b6480a271bcfe73.png] 

Similarly,

'PIE' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d81b41655eb77670076f3062a7ea34b1ca4b00fe59c7cac65a06773083daa2dd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/061f0005fec544c68de37dd7c54cb7ea256f0749603f6dbe0610f88db9a2fbdb.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
